About

pkcentraL is an alternative R&B artist and songwriter from Kissimmee, Florida, whose music explores the tension between emotional honesty and personal ambition. Through layered melodies, intimate writing, and understated production, he captures the thoughts people usually keep to themselves—the conversations after love fades, the pressure to become someone greater, and the quiet moments in between.
